analyst_view.overall: Early view: Thun, coached by Gian-Luca Privitelli, got their first league-phase win by beating Hearts 3-1 on their artificial pitch after defeats to Twente and Hajduk. Rik De Mil's Gent have won once in their last five games and drew 0-0 at KuPS. Both sides sit mid-table and need points for the top 24.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean a little lower: Gent have not scored away in the league phase (0-2 at Braga, 0-0 at KuPS), though Thun's Brighton Labeau and Furkan Dursun both scored against Hearts, so a home goal is likely.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. Gent's best moments at KuPS came from Hyllarion Goore's runs down the right, which can win corners, but nothing points clearly off the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. The referee is not known and there is no history of bad feeling between the clubs, so I stay with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots. Gent had no shots on target in the first half at KuPS but dominated after the break, and Thun take their chances at home, so nothing moves me off the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Gent have been short of quality in the final third and Thun were sharp against Hearts; those roughly cancel out, so I stay with the estimate.
